infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pickleague uses your location to show courts near you, to look for a court you're at for check-in prompts, and to confirm you're at a court when you check in or start a play session there.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Pickleague uses your contacts so you can pick people to invite. Only the people you choose are sent.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pickleague uses your photo library so you can choose a profile picture, or save your club's QR code to your QR wallet.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Pickleague saves images you choose to save, like your season or tournament finish card, to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: At courts you've starred, Pickleague can check you in automatically when you arrive and stay a minute (leave within 5 minutes and it doesn't count). Otherwise it only sends check-in prompts. At a court where you saved a QR code, it lets you open that code with one tap when you arrive. You can turn this off in Settings.
